name: NESORA DIGITAL
role: Websites and mobile apps for local businesses
intro: Affordable, modern and easy-to-use digital tools for supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, gyms, salons and other small businesses.
about: We develop affordable, modern, and user-friendly websites and mobile applications for local businesses that don't have an online presence yet, or need to improve their existing digital services. Using AI-assisted development tools, we build each solution around the needs of your business while keeping costs low.

services.title: Responsive websites
services.text: Fast websites that look good on phones, tablets and desktops.

services.title: Catalogues & online menus
services.text: Show your products or dishes and update them yourself.

services.title: Booking systems
services.text: Let customers book classes, appointments and tables online.

services.title: Ordering platforms
services.text: Take orders for pickup or delivery without paying marketplace fees.

services.title: Admin dashboards
services.text: Manage orders, bookings, products and customers in one place.

services.title: Mobile applications
services.text: Android and iOS apps built with React Native.

services.title: Deployment & domain setup
services.text: We put your site online and connect your own web address.

services.title: Maintenance & support
services.text: Updates, fixes and technical help whenever you need them.
